# Count the number of players per round
round_counts = df['round'].value_counts().sort_index()

# Filter rounds between 3 and 9 inclusive
relevant_rounds = round_counts[(round_counts.index >= 3) & (round_counts.index <= 9)]

# Check if all these rounds have exactly 2 players
answer = all(relevant_rounds == 2)
